times.table_fact: This table contains one row per calendar day from 2019-01-01 to 2023-12-31 (1826 days). It provides both calendar and fiscal date hierarchies with week, month, quarter, and year levels. The fiscal calendar does not align with calendar months—fiscal months can span two calendar months and have varying lengths (25-35 days), with fiscal year starting in January but with irregular boundaries.

database_note: The sales and costs tables record events. Sales track individual transactions, while costs store unit pricing per product, time, promotion, and channel. The remaining tables are lookups. Channels, countries, customers, products, promotions, supplementary demographics, and times provide descriptive context. Sales connects to customers via cust_id, to products via prod_id, to times via time_id, to channels via channel_id, and to promotions via promo_id. Costs links to products via prod_id, times via time_id, channels via channel_id, and promotions via promo_id. Customers relate to countries through country_id. Supplementary demographics attach to customers via cust_id. Times serves as the central date dimension for both sales and costs. Use these joins to combine transactional data with descriptive attributes for analysis.
